clips.send: A friend who just got written up at work for being five minutes late - unease at how differently the rules apply depending on who signs your paycheck, and quiet anger that they're the one paying for it.
clips.caption:
Come to work drunk. Don't show up for three days. Refuse the assignment outright. In most of the world, any one of those ends the job the same day.

Not here. A federal employee can do all three and keep collecting a paycheck - then retire on ninety percent of that pay for the rest of their life, with full medical covered. No performance review stops it. No manager's word is final. The job was never designed to be lost.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how this system was built to work this way.

clips.send: A friend who just got promoted into management and thinks the title alone is enough - unease at how fast not knowing the ground floor can sink a company, awe at the comparison to its biggest rival.
clips.caption:
The CEO of one of America's biggest retailers ran the company for three years without once walking into one of his own stores - or a competitor's. He said so himself, on CNBC.

Sam Walton ran Walmart the opposite way: half of his working life, on foot, inside his own stores and his rivals'. One company is a case study now. The other doesn't exist. Being in charge and knowing what's happening on the ground are not the same skill.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the rest of this comparison.

clips.send: A friend who just paid their taxes and feels good about it - anger at watching exactly where some of that money actually goes, and the urge to send this to everyone who still trusts the system blindly.
clips.caption:
They took the brand new TVs the government had just bought and loaded them into their own cars. Same with the chairs. He watched it happen, in person, more than once.

Call it what it is: theft, funded by the money you send in every year. And it isn't rare. There are people inside the federal government now whose whole job is chasing this exact kind of fraud, and he says he'll be the first to testify to what he's seen. He says thousands of others could too.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the rest of what he's seen.
